verses.text: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
lines: “Call now; is there any who will answer you?
To which of the holy ones will you turn?

verses.text: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
lines: For resentment kills the foolish man,
and jealousy kills the simple.

verses.text: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
lines: I have seen the foolish taking root,
but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

verses.text: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
lines: His children are far from safety.
They are crushed in the gate.
Neither is there any to deliver them,

verses.text: whose harvest the hungry eats up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.
lines: whose harvest the hungry eats up,
and take it even out of the thorns.
The snare gapes for their substance.

verses.text: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;
lines: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust,
neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

verses.text: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
lines: but man is born to trouble,
as the sparks fly upward.

verses.text: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
lines: “But as for me, I would seek God.
I would commit my cause to God,

verses.text: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
lines: who does great things that can’t be fathomed,
marvelous things without number;

verses.text: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;
lines: who gives rain on the earth,
and sends waters on the fields;

verses.text: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
lines: so that he sets up on high those who are low,
those who mourn are exalted to safety.

verses.text: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
lines: He frustrates the plans of the crafty,
So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

verses.text: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
lines: He takes the wise in their own craftiness;
the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

verses.text: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.
lines: They meet with darkness in the day time,
and grope at noonday as in the night.

verses.text: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
lines: But he saves from the sword of their mouth,
even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

verses.text: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.
lines: So the poor has hope,
and injustice shuts her mouth.

verses.text: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
lines: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects.
Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

verses.text: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
lines: For he wounds and binds up.
He injures and his hands make whole.

verses.text: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
lines: He will deliver you in six troubles;
yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

verses.text: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
lines: In famine he will redeem you from death;
in war, from the power of the sword.

verses.text: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.
lines: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue,
neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

verses.text: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
lines: You will laugh at destruction and famine,
neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

verses.text: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.
lines: For you will be allied with the stones of the field.
The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

verses.text: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.
lines: You will know that your tent is in peace.
You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

verses.text: You will know also that your offspring will be great, Your offspring as the grass of the earth.
lines: You will know also that your offspring will be great,
Your offspring as the grass of the earth.

verses.text: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
lines: You will come to your grave in a full age,
like a shock of grain comes in its season.

verses.text: Look at this. We have searched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
lines: Look at this. We have searched it. It is so.
Hear it, and know it for your good.”
